newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Battle plans to spend US$40 mln on Vera.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Battle plans to spend US$40 mln on Vera.

text.p: U.S. gold miner Battle Mountain Gold Co said on Wednesday about US$40 million would be spent on a capital development programme at the Vera-Nancy gold prospect in the Australian state of Queensland, with initial production expected early in 1997.
The Vera-Nancy project is 50 percent owned by each of Battle Mountain and Normandy Mining Ltd, which is the operating partner.
The project has been estimated to contain one million ounces of gold mineralisation.

"Mining of the underground Nancy ore is targetted to begin in late 1996, with full production anticipated by August 1997, through initial ore processed through the mill is expected to come from the relatively low-grade Vera open pit," Battle Mountain said.
"Mining of the Vera open pit is expected to begin in September and conclude in December, when the second decline is targetted to commence," it said.

"When in full operation, the current proposal calls for processing through the Pajingo mill of approximately 245,000 tonnes of ore per year, grading an average of 0.41 ounces of gold per tonne, or approximately 100,000 ounces of gold."
Battle Mountain is listed in Australia and the United States.
